create_XpuCommunicator: create an XpuCommunicator instance with a CPU process group and optional device group for XPU distributed communication
test_all_reduce: test the all_reduce method that performs an all-reduce operation on a torch tensor across the device group
test_reduce_scatter: test the reduce_scatter method that reduces and scatters a tensor across ranks along a specified dimension
test_reduce_scatterv: test the reduce_scatterv method that performs variable-size reduce-scatter with optional per-rank size specifications
test_all_gatherv: test the all_gatherv method that gathers variable-size tensors from all ranks along dimension 0
build_gather_method: build a gather method that collects tensors from all ranks and reshapes them on the destination rank
test_broadcast: test the broadcast method that broadcasts a tensor from a source rank to all ranks in the device group
test_dispatch: test the dispatch method that dispatches hidden states and topk weights/ids to appropriate devices via all2all manager
test_combine: test the combine method that combines hidden states from all ranks back together via all2all manager
